influences.name: Anton Webern
influences.context: As in the music of Morton Feldman, also a member of "The New York School", one hears the harmonic and melodic influence of Anton Webern's music.

influences.name: Charles Ives
influences.context: However, in the music of Wolff, one hears also the kinship with the music of Charles Ives, a music less of counterpoint but rather a tumultuous flow of simultaneous, equally important melodies

influences.name: Merce Cunningham
influences.context: I've heard that Merce Cunningham was an influence on your work. I didn't really notice that for a while but I followed the company from the '50's before Merce had put a company together. I came to realize in the '70's that the way that Merce structured his dances with the continuity and the discontinuity, simultaneous things going on, these were very close to the way that I thought about structure.
